summary: Completed comprehensive testing of KaalChakra V2 multilingual features. All 25 backend API tests passed (100% success rate). All frontend V2 features tested and working: language switcher (EN/HI/MR), Then vs Now image comparison slider, multilingual fort content (Devanagari), quiz in Hindi, Ask the King in Marathi, leaderboard translations, and mobile responsive language switcher. V1 regression tests passed - all existing features still work correctly.
